Can I have your attention, please, everyone. ® We will
begin producing the next generation of our best-selling car
model next quarter. ®We have already received all the
parts we need, so we can start the assembly process in
July. As supervisors, you'll have to reassign some tasks
for your workers on the factory floor. i'll be e-mailing you
information on production targets and timelines to help you
do that. Thank you for your cooperation.
